Let
\[
r(\omega)=\left|(i\omega)^2+a(i\omega)+1\right|
=\sqrt{(1-\omega^2)^2+a^2\omega^2}\qquad(\omega>0).
\]
Define
\[
D(a,c)=\inf_{\omega>0}\bigl(r(\omega)-c\omega\bigr),
\]
whenever \(c<a\). Since
\[
\frac{r(\omega)}{\omega}
=\sqrt{\left(\omega-\frac1\omega\right)^2+a^2}\ge a,
\]
we have \(r(\omega)-c\omega>0\) for every \(\omega>0\) if and only if \(c<a\), and then \(D(a,c)>0\).

The answer is:

\[
\boxed{
\begin{cases}
0\le c<a,\quad 0\le b<D(a,c), &\text{or}\\[2mm]
c=0,\ a\ge \sqrt2,\ 0\le b\le 1.
\end{cases}}
\]

Here, in the second line, \(D(a,0)=1\), but the infimum is not attained.

Proof sketch, self-contained:

For \(\lambda=x+iy\), \(x\ge0\), write \(\rho=|\lambda|\). A direct expansion gives
\[
|\lambda^2+a\lambda+1|^2
=
\rho^4+(a^2-2)\rho^2+1
+4\rho^2\cos^2\theta
+2a\rho(\rho^2+1)\cos\theta,
\]
where \(\lambda=\rho e^{i\theta}\) and \(\cos\theta=x/\rho\ge0\). Hence
\[
|\lambda^2+a\lambda+1|\ge r(\rho).
\]
If \(c<a\) and \(b<D(a,c)\), then for every \(\lambda\ne0\) with \(\Re\lambda\ge0\),
\[
|\lambda^2+a\lambda+1|
\ge r(|\lambda|)
> b+c|\lambda|.
\]
But
\[
\left|b e^{-\lambda\tau}+c\lambda e^{-\lambda\sigma}\right|
\le b+c|\lambda|,
\]
so \(\Delta_{\tau,\sigma}(\lambda)\ne0\). Also \(\Delta_{\tau,\sigma}(0)=1+b>0\). Thus no root lies in \(\Re\lambda\ge0\).

Conversely, for \(\lambda=i\omega\), \(\omega>0\), the phases \(e^{-i\omega\tau}\) and \(e^{-i\omega\sigma}\) can be chosen arbitrarily on the unit circle. Therefore \(i\omega\) is a root for some delays exactly when the three lengths
\[
b,\qquad c\omega,\qquad r(\omega)
\]
can form a triangle:
\[
|b-c\omega|\le r(\omega)\le b+c\omega.
\]
Equivalently,
\[
b\in \bigl[\,|r(\omega)-c\omega|,\ r(\omega)+c\omega\,\bigr].
\]
If \(c\ge a\), then \(r(\omega)=c\omega\) for some \(\omega>0\), and the union of these intervals is all of \([0,\infty)\), so every \(b\ge0\) produces a nonnegative-real-part root. If \(c<a\), the union is \([D(a,c),\infty)\), except when \(c=0\) and \(a\ge\sqrt2\), where it is \((1,\infty)\). This gives exactly the boxed classification.
